scripts.add:android: npm run prepare:web && cap add android
scripts.add:ios: npm run prepare:web && cap add ios
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios:simulator: npm run sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:ios:device: npm run sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphoneos -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData-device CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
